hooks.name: Stack running before a spec task
hooks.description: Blocks a spec task when the Docker stack is down: make test, the only completion gate, cannot run without it.

action.command: docker compose exec -T php true >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'The Docker stack is not running: start it with `make up` before executing a spec task (make test needs it).' >&2; exit 1; }

hooks.name: make test after a spec task
hooks.description: A spec task is done only when make test is green (see .kiro/steering/spec-execution.md).

action.prompt: Run `make test` now and paste its full output. If it is red, the task is NOT done: untick its box in tasks.md if you ticked it, do not commit, and either fix the failure or explain what blocks. If it is green, make sure the task has exactly one commit following .kiro/steering/git-conventions.md, tasks.md included.
